node.title: Every guarded three-petal LS6 atom obeys an inverse source-ratio degree gate
node.statement: For every live guarded LS6 atom, not only the high-multiplier range, let F be the canonical inverse of Etilde modulo L_2L_3. Nonemptiness forces deg(F)>=ell+a. The source CRT residues give F=L_1+L_2A, where A is the degree-below-ell representative of (lambda^(-1)-1)L_1L_2^(-1) modulo L_3. Hence nonemptiness forces deg rem_(L_3)(L_1L_2^(-1))>=a, independently of lambda. The failure branch is exactly a source syzygy L_1=U L_2+R L_3 with deg U,deg R<a. Common-pencil triples are the degree-zero case and are empty.
